title: Dynamic Lagging using Stable-Prefix Training for Simultaneous Translation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05799v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In streaming simultaneous speech translation, the speech translation system is trained to learn a read-write policy that alternates between consuming source words and generating target ones.   In a cascaded setting, the output from the speech recognizer is passed to a separate machine translation component, making it more difficult to learn such a policy.   Approximations such as fixed wait-k strategies or target-suffix deletion can be employed, but these approaches do not provide the model with a streaming system's flexibility to make contextual read-write decisions.   This paper presents a training strategy for a cascaded machine translation system that enables it to dynamically decide how much of the growing source prefix to translate. translated_title: 基于稳定前缀训练的动态滞后同步翻译方法
translated_abstract: 在流式同步语音翻译中，语音翻译系统需要学习一种读写策略，在读取源语言单词和生成目标语言单词之间交替进行。在级联设置中，语音识别器的输出被传递给一个独立的机器翻译组件，这使得学习这种策略变得更加困难。虽然可以采用固定wait-k策略或目标后缀删除等近似方法，但这些方法无法赋予模型流式系统根据上下文灵活做出读写决策的能力。本文提出了一种针对级联机器翻译系统的训练策略，使其能够动态决定翻译不断增长的源语言前缀中的多少内容。我们通过在训练数据的稳定前缀上微调大语言模型（Qwen3-8B）来实现这一目标，这些稳定前缀是通过将训练数据中的每个源句子前缀与相应目标内容配对而生成的。
tldr: 本文提出一种稳定前缀训练策略，通过微调大语言模型Qwen3-8B，使级联机器翻译系统能够动态决定翻译不断增长的源语言前缀的多少内容，从而实现比固定wait-k等近似方法更灵活的同步翻译。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a stable-prefix training strategy that fine-tunes a large language model (Qwen3-8B) to enable a cascaded machine translation system to dynamically decide how much of the growing source prefix to translate, achieving greater flexibility than fixed wait-k approximations in simultaneous translation.
